challenge.reason: The argument does not engage with the old decision. The old decision explicitly forbids secrets being written to .faff/, not only committed to the repo; gitignoring the cache addresses only the commit half. A plaintext credentials file at rest widens the exposure surface (backups, other local processes, sandboxes that mount the worktree, leftover keys after rotation) and breaks the env-only source-of-truth rule. The justification is a small, unquantified latency saving: reading process.env is an in-memory lookup, negligible next to an LLM network call, and an in-process memo would get the same benefit with no file. The trade gives up a security guardrail for a speculative performance gain.
